detail.longDescription: 🚀 Hello DEV! Let’s Build Something Cool! Finally joining the DEV Community! 👋 I'm Yashika, an M.Tech CSE student who enjoys turning random ideas into actual projects. 💻 I’m currently exploring: 🤖 AI & Machine Learning 🌐 Full-Stack Development 📱 Flutter 🔬 AI Research ⚡ And a lot of experiments that sometimes work... and sometimes don't 😅 From building web apps to training deep learning models, I'm learning something new with every project. I’ll be sharing my projects, experiments, failures, research, and things I learn along the way. No idea where this journey goes, but let's build and find out. 🚀 What are you building right now? 👇 # ai # learning # machinelearning # webdev # software # coding # development # engineering # inclusive # community 🚀 Hello DEV!
